name: com.weav/mcp
title: Weav
description: Sign up for Weav in chat, set up your AI agent, triage conversations, and manage your Help Center.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Sign the user up for a free Weav account without leaving the chat. Emails a 6-digit code to the address the user gives you. No sign-in needed. Next, call verify_signup_code with that code.

email.description: The user's work email. Ask the user for it; never guess.

tools.name: verify_signup_code
tools.description: Check the 6-digit code from start_signup and create the user's Weav workspace. Returns a setup_key that the setup tools accept for 24 hours, so setup can continue in chat. If the email already has a workspace, tells you to have the user sign in instead. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

code.description: The 6-digit code from the Weav email.

company_name.description: The user's company or brand name; used as the workspace name. Ask the user.

tools.name: get_setup_status
tools.description: Get the workspace's setup checklist, the next step, AI credits left, and plans. Use it right after signup and whenever the user asks what to do next. Pass setup_key from verify_signup_code, or call it while signed in. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

tools.name: start_website_training
tools.description: Crawl the user's website and add its pages to the AI agent's private training data. Same as the website step of web onboarding; no AI credits are used. Runs in the background; check progress with get_training_status. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

website.description: Public website or docs URL, for example acme.com.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

tools.name: get_training_status
tools.description: Check website training started with start_website_training: crawl status, pages found and trained, and how many training sources the workspace has. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

training_session_id.description: training_session_id from start_website_training. Omit for the latest one.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

tools.name: get_chat_widget_install
tools.description: Get the script that adds the Weav AI chat widget to the user's website, with install instructions. Share it with the user or their developer. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

tools.name: kb_start_import
tools.description: Copy an existing public help center (Zendesk, Intercom, HelpScout, etc.) into the Weav Help Center knowledge base. The Help Center stays private until the user goes live. Only works while the Weav Help Center is empty and not live. Check progress with kb_import_status. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

url.description: Public URL of the existing help center, for example help.acme.com.

instructions.description: Optional notes for the import, for example which sections to skip.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

tools.name: kb_import_status
tools.description: Check a help center import started with kb_start_import: stage, article counts, verification, and the review link. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

tools.name: create_checkout_link
tools.description: Create a Stripe Checkout link to subscribe to a plan or buy more AI credits. Nothing is charged until the user pays on the Stripe page. Plans: plus, pro, max (with interval monthly or yearly) and ai_credits (1,000-credit packs, needs a plan). Workspaces on credit billing (billing.credit_billing in get_setup_status) use credit_plan or credit_top_up instead. Confirm the choice with the user first. Always pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on every setup call, even when OAuth is signed in; the key takes precedence over OAuth.

interval.description: Billing interval for plus, pro or max. Defaults to monthly.

quantity.description: Number of 1,000-credit packs for ai_credits. Defaults to 1.

setup_key.description: Pass the setup_key from verify_signup_code on EVERY setup call, even when OAuth is signed in to another workspace. It selects the workspace and takes precedence over OAuth. Omit only to use the OAuth-connected workspace.

tools.name: search_conversations
tools.description: Search Weav support conversations the same way the inbox does: only conversations with at least one message. Spam is excluded unless spam is true.

query.description: Search subject, customer name, or email.

spam.description: When true, return spam conversations instead of inbox conversations.

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Get a Weav conversation, including recent messages. Pass conversation_id from search_conversations (that tool returns id). Do not use a customer, message, or other model id.

conversation_id.description: Conversation ID from search_conversations (the id field on those results). Do not pass a customer, message, or other model id.

tools.name: search_customers
tools.description: Search Weav customers by name or email.

tools.name: get_customer
tools.description: Get a Weav customer profile, company, and recent conversations.

tools.name: search_training_data
tools.description: Search agent training data that Weav AI agents answer from by title, description, type, or source. Help Center articles are separate; use kb_search_articles.

tools.name: get_training_data
tools.description: Get a single agent training data item that Weav AI agents answer from. Help Center articles are separate and use the kb_* tools.

tools.name: kb_get_overview
tools.description: Get counts and locales for the workspace Help Center public knowledge base. This is separate from agent training data managed by the *_training_data tools.

tools.name: kb_list_categories
tools.description: List categories in the workspace Help Center public knowledge base. This is separate from agent training data managed by the *_training_data tools.

tools.name: kb_list_sections
tools.description: List sections in the workspace Help Center public knowledge base.

tools.name: kb_list_articles
tools.description: List summaries of the workspace Help Center public knowledge base articles. This is separate from agent training data managed by the *_training_data tools.

category_id.description: Filter to a Help Center category UUID. Do not combine with uncategorized.

uncategorized.description: When true, include only articles without a Help Center category.

locale.description: Keep only translations for this locale, such as en or en-US (maximum 10 characters).

tools.name: kb_search_articles
tools.description: Search public Help Center knowledge base article titles and content. This is separate from agent training data; use search_training_data for data Weav AI agents answer from.

query.description: Search words or phrases from Help Center article titles and markdown content (1-255 characters).

locale.description: Search only this locale, such as en or en-US (maximum 10 characters).

category_id.description: Filter to a Help Center category UUID.

uncategorized.description: When true, include only articles without a Help Center category.

tools.name: kb_get_article
tools.description: Get a full public Help Center knowledge base article, including translation content. This is separate from agent training data managed by the *_training_data tools.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article to retrieve.

locale.description: Optionally keep only this locale translation, such as en or en-US (maximum 10 characters).

tools.name: kb_get_preview_link
tools.description: Get a shareable link to preview a draft Help Center article or a pending KB proposal inside the whole Help Center. Anyone with the link can view it; it never expires and is not indexed. Pass `regenerate: true` to replace the link so the old one stops working.

article_id.description: UUID of the draft Help Center article to preview. Provide exactly one of article_id or proposal_id.

proposal_id.description: UUID of the pending Help Center proposal to preview. Provide exactly one of article_id or proposal_id.

regenerate.description: Replace the current link; the old link stops working.

tools.name: kb_list_article_revisions
tools.description: List redacted revision summaries for a Help Center public knowledge base article. This is separate from agent training data managed by the *_training_data tools.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article whose revisions to list.

locale.description: Optionally filter revisions to this locale, such as en or en-US (maximum 10 characters).

tools.name: kb_get_article_revision
tools.description: Get full revision content for a Help Center public knowledge base article. This is separate from agent training data managed by the *_training_data tools.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article that owns the revision.

revision_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article revision to retrieve.

tools.name: kb_list_proposals
tools.description: List improvement proposals for the workspace Help Center public knowledge base. This is separate from agent training data managed by the *_training_data tools.

status.description: Filter by proposal status; ignored proposals are omitted by default.

tools.name: kb_get_proposal
tools.description: Get full details for an improvement proposal in the workspace Help Center public knowledge base. This is separate from agent training data managed by the *_training_data tools.

proposal_id.description: UUID of the Help Center improvement proposal to retrieve.

tools.name: kb_edit_proposal
tools.description: Save a pending Help Center improvement proposal's title and Markdown without publishing. Keeps a new-article draft synchronized; updates leave the published article unchanged. Read with kb_get_proposal first. Use this rather than kb_update_article for suggestion drafts. Separate from agent training data.

proposal_id.description: UUID of the pending Help Center improvement proposal to edit.

title.description: Full replacement title, at most 255 characters.

content.description: Full replacement Markdown, including image URLs and native components; at most 1,048,576 characters. Saving does not publish.

tools.name: kb_create_article
tools.description: Search first with kb_search_articles and update an existing article instead of creating a duplicate. New articles are drafts by default; status=published publishes immediately.

status.description: New articles default to draft; published articles go live immediately.

excerpt.description: Optional excerpt, used as the meta description when seo_description is empty.

seo_title.description: Search and social title; the page heading stays title.

seo_description.description: Search and social description; the visible excerpt is unchanged.

noindex.description: Hide this page from search engines.

tools.name: kb_update_article
tools.description: Update an existing Help Center article. Content edits to an existing locale save a revision; SEO-only edits do not. Adding a locale requires both title and content.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article to update.

expected_version.description: Version returned by kb_get_article; prevents overwriting a newer edit.

category_id.description: Optional category UUID. Send null to uncategorize; omit to keep the current category.

translations.description: Optional locale edits. Content edits to existing locales save revisions; SEO-only edits do not. New locales require title and content.

excerpt.description: Optional excerpt update, used as the meta description when seo_description is empty.

seo_title.description: Search and social title; the page heading stays title.

seo_description.description: Search and social description; the visible excerpt is unchanged.

noindex.description: Hide this page from search engines.

tools.name: kb_publish_article
tools.description: Publish a Help Center article immediately. Read the article first and pass its current expected_version.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article to publish.

expected_version.description: Version returned by kb_get_article; prevents publishing a newer edit with stale data.

tools.name: kb_unpublish_article
tools.description: Unpublish a Help Center article and return it to draft. Read the article first and pass its current expected_version.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article to unpublish.

expected_version.description: Version returned by kb_get_article; prevents unpublishing after a newer edit.

tools.name: kb_delete_article
tools.description: Delete a Help Center article. This is destructive and soft-deletes the article. Read it first and pass its current expected_version.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article to soft-delete.

expected_version.description: Version returned by kb_get_article; prevents deleting a newer edit.

tools.name: kb_delete_article_translation
tools.description: Delete one locale translation from a Help Center article. This is destructive and an article must keep at least one translation. Read the article first and pass its current expected_version.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article to update.

locale.description: Locale translation to delete, such as en.

expected_version.description: Version returned by kb_get_article; prevents deleting a newer edit.

tools.name: kb_restore_article_revision
tools.description: Restore an article translation to the selected prior revision, saving the current translation as a new revision first. Read the article first and pass its current expected_version.

article_id.description: UUID of the Help Center article to restore.

revision_id.description: UUID of the revision to restore.

expected_version.description: Version returned by kb_get_article; prevents restoring over a newer edit.

tools.name: kb_reorder_articles
tools.description: Set the order of all articles in one Help Center category group.

ids.description: All article UUIDs in the desired order for this category group.

category_id.description: Category UUID to reorder. Omit or send null to reorder uncategorized articles.

tools.name: kb_create_category
tools.description: Create a category in the workspace Help Center.

section_id.description: Optional UUID of a Help Center section.

tools.name: kb_update_category
tools.description: Update a Help Center category name, slug, or display position.

category_id.description: UUID of the Help Center category to update.

section_id.description: Optional UUID of a Help Center section; null clears it.

tools.name: kb_delete_category
tools.description: Delete a Help Center category. This is destructive; its articles become uncategorized.

category_id.description: UUID of the Help Center category to delete.

tools.name: kb_reorder_categories
tools.description: Set the display order of all Help Center categories.

ids.description: All category UUIDs in the desired display order.

tools.name: kb_create_section
tools.description: Create a section in the workspace Help Center.

tools.name: kb_update_section
tools.description: Update a Help Center section name, slug, or display position.

section_id.description: UUID of the Help Center section to update.

tools.name: kb_delete_section
tools.description: Delete a Help Center section. Categories assigned to it become unsectioned.

section_id.description: UUID of the Help Center section to delete.

tools.name: kb_reorder_sections
tools.description: Set the display order of all Help Center sections.

ids.description: All section UUIDs in the desired display order.

tools.name: send_reply
tools.description: Post a reply to a Weav conversation as a workspace teammate.

tools.name: update_conversation
tools.description: Update a Weav conversation status, priority, or assignee. Does not delete conversations.

assignee_id.description: User or agent UUID. Omit to leave unchanged; send null to unassign.

assignee_type.description: Type of assignee when assignee_id is set.

tools.name: add_training_data
tools.description: Add Weav agent training data as text, Q&A, or a website URL. A website URL is crawled; every discovered page is trained. Every agent in the workspace is given access automatically.

type.description: Kind of training data to add.

url.description: Website URL to crawl. Weav discovers pages on the site and trains on all of them.

urls.description: Specific pages to train without crawling. Use url for a whole website.

tools.name: delete_training_data
tools.description: Delete an agent training data item in Weav. For website/URL sources this also deletes discovered URLs and chunks.

tools.name: resync_training_data
tools.description: Re-scrape an existing URL agent training data item in Weav.
